lines: First in self-knowing, then resting in the
knowable, let him bring the knowable to fullness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pūrvaṃ svabodhe tadanu prameye viśramya meyaṃ paripūrayeta

reads_against.argmap: What is the order of completion? → svabodha → prameya-viśrānti → meya-paripūraṇa: knowing first, object completed last.
c1_essence: Own-knowing first, then knowable-rest, then complete the knowable.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with abhyāsa weight (quiescence as disciplined practice)
